text.jp:
……さあ、クリスタルに触れるのです。
はるかな異界の物語に、想いを馳せましょう。
text.official_en: Now, lay your hand upon the crystal, so it may weave a tale of a distant world.
text.real_en: Now, touch the crystal... and turn your thoughts to the tale of a distant world.

text.jp:
……そんなふうに純粋な想いだけで戦うことを
クライヴは願っていたのかもしれません。
text.official_en: Those are indeed noble ideals, and perhaps Clive wished to live by them...yet we cannot know for certain.
text.real_en: Perhaps Clive wished he could fight with such pure intentions alone...

text.jp:
……力を求めし者よ。
よくぞ来ました。
text.official_en: Ah, yes, it was but a matter of time before you would find your way here.
text.real_en: ...You who seek power. Welcome.

text.jp:
ああ……迷わないのですね、クライヴのように。
その想いが光となって、世界を変えるでしょう。
text.official_en: And yet, you would shoulder them all without hesitation—much as Clive did. With such resolve, you will make countless inroads on your journey.
text.real_en: Ah... You would not hesitate, just like Clive. That resolve will become a light that changes the world.

text.jp:
あなたが彼らを知らずとも、心が響きあったなら
彼らのビジョンが、あなたの力となります。
text.official_en: Though you know not these heroes, they shall come to know you, and should your soul resonate with theirs, they shall lend you their strength.
text.real_en: Even if you do not know them, if your hearts resonate, their Visions will become your strength.

text.jp:
あなたが望むのは、力に支配されるよりも
力に頼らず、自由に生きられる世界ですね。
text.official_en: You find the lack of agency suffocating. Rather than walk a road that has already been laid for you, you wish to walk your own.
text.real_en: You want a world where people can live freely without relying on power, rather than being ruled by it.

text.jp:
あなたとクライヴは、とてもよく似て
たがいの想いが共鳴するでしょう。
text.official_en: You and he are similar in many ways, and the two of you complement each other exceedingly well.
text.real_en: You and Clive are very much alike. Your feelings will surely resonate.

text.jp:
あなたとクライヴは、少し違うけれど
異なる想いが響きあうでしょう。
text.official_en: While you and he have your differences, those differences will ultimately prove to be your greatest strength.
text.real_en: You and Clive are a little different, but your different feelings will resonate with each other.

text.jp:
あなたなら、ビジョンの力を正しく使えるはず。
信じていますよ……。
text.official_en: I have the utmost faith you will wield his power with all the wisdom it is due.
text.real_en: I believe you can use the power of Visions wisely...

text.jp:
ありがとう……。
想いを、たしかに受け取りました。
text.official_en: Thank you for those glimpses into your soul. Now then...
text.real_en: Thank you... I have received your feelings.

text.jp:
いまではなく、ここでもない異界で
人々の記憶に残る、幻想の英雄たち……。
text.official_en:
A reliquary for the memories of heroes fantastical in nature—
scattered across myriad realms and epochs.
text.real_en: Heroes of legend, remembered by people in other worlds, in times and places far removed from our own...

text.jp:
けれどクライヴにとっては、失われたものが
あまりに大きく、忘れられなかったのです。
text.official_en: For Clive, however, such a task was too great—his pain too visceral for it to ever leave his mind.
text.real_en: But for Clive, what he had lost was too great to forget.

text.jp:
ここはビジョンクリスタルの祠……
異界につながる聖域です。
text.official_en: Welcome to the Vision Crystal Sanctum—a nexus between planes of existence...
text.real_en: This is the Vision Crystal Sanctum... a sacred place connected to other worlds.

text.jp:
これからの問いかけに
あなたの想いを、答えてください。
text.official_en: Henceforth, I shall pose to you three questions.
text.real_en: Answer the questions I am about to ask with what is in your heart.

text.jp:
それでもクライヴは、完璧な正解のない選択に
悔いることなく、命を懸けたのです。
text.official_en: While none of Clive’s options were perfect, he chose the one he would stake his life on—and regretted it not in the least.

text.jp:
それでもクライヴは罪の意識から逃げず、
己の力を償いに費やすように生きたのです。
text.official_en: Clive would not forgive himself his crime, and much like you, would eventually choose to spend his life atoning for it rather than running from it.
text.real_en: Even so, Clive did not flee from his guilt. He lived as though devoting his powers to atonement.

text.jp: それは、召喚獣が覇権を決する異界の記憶――
text.official_en: A world where those who control the Eikons determine who holds dominion.
text.real_en: A memory of another world where summoned beasts determine who holds dominion...

text.jp:
どんな言葉であろうと、心を開いて
想いを示せば、それは絆となります。
text.official_en: Answer them truthfully and you shall forge a bond with that hero, regardless of what those words are.
text.real_en: Whatever words you choose, open your heart and express your feelings. That will form a bond.

text.jp:
めざめた力を振るいながら、戦う意味を
考えていく。それはクライヴも同じでした。
text.official_en: Having wrought inadvertent havoc himself, Clive pondered not only the limits of his newfound strength, but what wielding it meant.
text.real_en: Clive also pondered the meaning of fighting while wielding his newly awakened powers.

text.jp:
クライヴの想いはビジョンとなって
きっとあなたの希望となります。
text.official_en: His thoughts shall coalesce into a vision, which will, in turn, bestow upon you hope.
text.real_en: Clive’s feelings will become a Vision, and surely a source of hope for you.

text.jp:
クライヴも復讐を願い、しかし犯人が自分かも
しれないとの疑念にさいなまれ、苦悩しました。
text.official_en: Clive, too, sought revenge to lessen his anguish, but he was continually plagued by one thought—that he may have been the one who took his brother’s life.
text.real_en: Clive wanted revenge too, but was tormented by the suspicion that he himself might be responsible.

text.jp:
世界の在り方や人々の生き方、すべてを
変える決断は、ひとりでは難しいものです。
text.official_en: When a decision affects not only people’s lives, but the very foundation of society, it can be difficult to make alone.
text.real_en: It is hard to decide on your own to change everything about the world and how people live.

text.jp:
世界の根源にかかわる危うい力と、力にともなう
責任を、あなたひとりで背負えるのですか？
text.official_en: The dangers that accompany such great and primordial power would be daunting to most, say nothing of the many burdens its use would entail.
text.real_en: Could you shoulder, all alone, a dangerous power tied to the foundations of the world—and the responsibility that comes with it?

text.jp:
人と人が支えあえば、希望はあります。
クライヴが願った世界と、きっと同じでしょう。
text.official_en: Clive had much the same goal, and so long as kind hearts and helping hands exist, it should be attainable.
text.real_en: If people support one another, there is hope. Surely it is the kind of world Clive wished for.

text.jp: 他人に利用されたくない
text.official_en: Vow not to be exploited.
text.real_en: Not want to be used by others.

text.jp:
力があるかないかで、人間の生き方が決まり、
運命を支配される。そんな現実を知ったら――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were you to one day realize a painful truth—that your lot in life was to be determined not by your own will, but by whether or not you possessed a certain power—what would you do?
text.real_en: If you learned that whether people had power determined how they lived and controlled their fate, what would you do?

text.jp: 力に頼らない世の中をつくる
text.official_en: Create a world in which that power’s role is removed.
text.real_en: Create a world where people do not have to rely on power.

text.jp:
力を得ても自由に使えず、他人の思惑どおりに
戦うしかないとしたら、むなしいものです。
text.official_en: Possessing immense power may seem freeing, but if you can only use it to do others’ bidding, you may as well have none at all.
text.real_en: It would feel hollow to gain power only to be forced to fight according to someone else’s will.

text.jp: 危険な力は自分が引き受ける
text.official_en: Assume said power so it does not fall into the wrong hands.
text.real_en: Take the burden of dangerous power upon yourself.

text.jp:
召喚の力を得たことで、生き方を縛られてしまう。
それがクライヴの背負った宿命でした。
text.official_en: For Clive, the Eikons’ powers may have opened new doors to him on the battlefield, but off of it, he felt they had closed many others.
text.real_en: Gaining the power to summon bound the way Clive could live. That was the fate he carried.

text.jp:
召喚獣を宿した者が、国家の存亡を懸けて
戦うことを運命づけられる世界。
text.official_en: Select individuals harbor these ethereal creatures within themselves, wielding their uncanny powers at the behest of nations.
text.real_en: A world where those who harbor Eikons are destined to fight for the survival of their nations.

text.jp:
召喚獣を宿すドミナントとなったものの
クライヴは非情な現実に直面し、苦悩します。
text.official_en: Though the powers he gained as a Dominant were great, Clive’s metamorphosis was—for many reasons—a curse rather than a gift.
text.real_en: Though he became a Dominant harboring an Eikon, Clive faced a cruel reality and suffered greatly.

text.jp:
大いなる力で、悪を討つ。弱き人々を守り、
疑いなく正しい目的のため、誇り高く戦う。
text.official_en: As you have been entrusted with a great power, you shall use it to protect those who cannot protect themselves. You shall be just in all you do, and hold your head high.
text.real_en: With great power, you would defeat evil, protect the weak, and fight with pride for what you know is right.

text.jp:
宿命の焔を宿す、異界の幻影　クライヴ
自由な未来のために、世界の罪を灼きはらう。
text.official_en:
Fatal Flame Clive
He who purged the world of its sin and kindled a brighter tomorrow.
text.real_en: An otherworldly Vision bearing the flames of fate: Clive. He burns away the world’s sins for the sake of a free future.

text.jp: 導いてくれる誰かに従う
text.official_en: Follow the guidance of another.
text.real_en: Follow someone who can guide you.

text.jp:
強大な力を手に入れたら、どこまでやれるか
試してみたい……誰もが抱く願望です。
text.official_en: Whether due to a purposeful effort or merely a loss of self-control, a warrior transcending their limits is not an uncommon sight.
text.real_en: If you gained enormous power, you would want to see just how much you could do. It is a wish anyone might have.

text.jp:
彼の名は、クライヴ……。
あなたの想いが、彼との絆になる。
text.official_en: That prince’s name is Clive, and it is with him you shall endeavor to forge a bond.
text.real_en: His name was Clive... Your feelings will form a bond with him.

text.jp:
彼の心にのしかかったのは、弟ジョシュアを
襲った悲劇にまつわる、罪の意識でした。
text.official_en: One of those reasons concerned his younger brother Joshua. In a tragic turn of events, Clive set upon him after transforming into an Eikon.
text.real_en: What weighed on his heart was guilt over the tragedy that had befallen his younger brother, Joshua.

text.jp:
心を解き放ち、自由に答えてください。
もしも、あなたが――
text.official_en: Now cast off the fetters of inhibition, bare your soul, and answer from your heart.
text.real_en: Open your heart and answer freely. If you were...

text.jp: 忘れて考えないようにする
text.official_en: Forget it ever happened.
text.real_en: Try to forget it and put it out of your mind.

text.jp: 思いっきり暴れてみる
text.official_en: Wreak havoc.
text.real_en: Let loose and go wild.

text.jp:
愛する者を奪われた、その怒りと悲しみを
ぶつけたい……人として当然の想いです。
text.official_en: To lose a loved one is indeed an agonizing prospect; nary a soul could suffer it without entertaining thoughts of revenge.
text.real_en: Wanting to lash out in anger and grief after losing someone you love is only human.

text.jp: 正義のために悪を討つ
text.official_en: Fight for good and justice.
text.real_en: Defeat evil in the name of justice.

text.jp:
王子として生まれながらも、召喚の素養に
恵まれず、剣に生きると誓った騎士がいました。
text.official_en: The Eikons can be fickle, however, as one prince was forced to take up the blade in lieu of their powers...until one fateful day.
text.real_en: There was a prince who, lacking the gift of summoning, swore to live by the sword as a knight.

text.jp:
癒やされぬ痛みなら、いっそ忘れてしまう。
それもまた、ひとつの生き方でしょう。
text.official_en: Though your pain may be so intense it could never be remedied, perhaps it could be forgotten.
text.real_en: If the pain can never heal, perhaps you would rather forget. That, too, is a way to live.

text.jp:
目の前で大切な弟が命を奪われ、
その犯人が自分かもしれないとしたら――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were your younger sibling to be taken from this world—not only before your very eyes, but perhaps even by your own hand—what would you do?
text.real_en: If your beloved younger brother were killed before your eyes and you suspected you might be the one responsible, what would you do?

text.jp:
秘められた力の覚醒によって
召喚獣に変身できるようになったら――
あなたなら、どうしますか？
text.official_en: Were a new power to awaken within you—one that allowed you to transform into a beast with extraordinary faculties—what would you do?
text.real_en: If a hidden power awakened within you and let you transform into an Eikon, what would you do?

text.jp:
自分の責任から目を背けなかったクライヴは
自身に宿る魔力と、世界の現実を考えます。
text.official_en: Ever one to understand the importance of duty, Clive often reflected upon the power that dwelled inside him and its place in the world.
text.real_en: Refusing to turn away from his own responsibility, Clive reflected on the magic within him and the reality of his world.

text.jp:
許されざる罪を背負って生きる。
それは死よりも重い罰かもしれません。
text.official_en: You would have your sin haunt you always and evermore—a punishment, some would say, many times more severe than death.
text.real_en: You would live bearing an unforgivable sin. That might be a punishment heavier than death.

text.jp: 許されなくても生きて償う
text.official_en: Live the rest of your life in atonement.
text.real_en: Live and atone, even if you can never be forgiven.

text.jp:
魔法が世界を支えるからこそ、力ある者ほど
しがらみに呪縛され、自由には生きられない。
text.official_en: If magic is the pillar upon which the world rests, those with more potent magic must bear more of that worldly load.
text.real_en: Precisely because magic sustains the world, those with power are bound by obligations and cannot live freely.

text.jp: 黒幕をさがして復讐したい
text.official_en: Find the person responsible.
text.real_en: Find the one behind it and seek revenge.
